directive.quote: a tool reads its list:settings row at run time through one shared Workshop reader; add to tools/settings, never beside it

job: run a program with the settings row its request names, read through the records door and handed to it

distinct_from.why: that command imports a JavaScript function and calls it with the door; this one reads one settings row through the door and hands it to a program in any language on its stdin, passing its output through
the folder's own readers take a record already handed in; this command is what hands it in, so the program never holds the door

run a program with the settings row its request names
